case: Computed expression metadata over STRICT ANY
change: Extend the direct-query metadata contract with a mixed CASE expression over a STRICT ANY column across ordinary, bound, empty-result and transaction query paths.
contract: A computed expression does not inherit the source column's declared ANY metadata; the result column keeps SQLx's NULL fallback metadata.
Per-row integer, SQL NULL and text values remain distinct in the returned Value cells.
SQLite typeof() independently reports integer, null and text for those computed-expression results.
Bound queries return the same values, and zero-row query/transaction results preserve fallback metadata without inventing rows.
Direct table-column queries continue to recover declared ANY metadata in ordinary, bound and transaction queries.

focused_case.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --test integration direct_query_columns_recover_declared_strict_any_metadata

sqlite_integration_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --test integration

remaining: Only one mixed CASE expression shape is covered; other computed expressions and consumer combinations remain open.
This test verifies query result semantics, not grid editing or installed GTK behavior.
